problem: A release may require both equal-process unreliability and planned-exposure unreliability to be below separate tolerances. Two marginal 95% confidence sequences do not by themselves give 95% simultaneous coverage, but the single conjunctive release decision has a sharper intersection-union construction.

setup.H_process: equal-process average conditional unreliability is at or above its unsafe tolerance tau_process
setup.H_exposure: planned-exposure weighted average conditional unreliability is at or above its unsafe tolerance tau_exposure
setup.safe_alternative: both reliability targets are below their respective tolerances
setup.component_requirement: For each channel, use an e-process valid for its own unsafe null with respect to the common filtration. Planned-exposure weights must remain predictable and frozen before current-block outcomes.

decision_rule.rule: At any joint stopping time, declare the conjunctive safe condition only when E_process >= 1/alpha AND E_exposure >= 1/alpha.
decision_rule.equivalent_joint_e_value: E_joint = min(E_process, E_exposure) at the chosen stopping time.
decision_rule.why_no_alpha_split_is_needed: Under the union null, at least one component null is true. If H_process is true then min(E_process,E_exposure) <= E_process, whose stopped expectation is <=1; similarly if H_exposure is true. Therefore the probability of falsely declaring both safe is at most alpha without requiring each component to use alpha/2.
decision_rule.classical_alignment: This is the anytime-valid e-value analogue of an intersection-union test: all component nulls must be rejected at level alpha to reject their union.

comparison_to_simultaneous_bounds.bonferroni_if_two_bounds_are_reported_jo: If the product needs a simultaneous 95% coverage statement for both numerical upper bounds themselves, a simple dependence-robust construction is alpha_process + alpha_exposure <= 0.05, e.g. 0.025 each.
comparison_to_simultaneous_bounds.decision_only_advantage: For the single AND decision, requiring both component e-values to cross 20 is valid and can be materially less conservative than requiring both to cross 40 under a 0.025/0.025 split.
comparison_to_simultaneous_bounds.do_not_conflate: The no-split IUT guarantee applies to the conjunctive decision event, not to a claim that two separately displayed 95% upper confidence sequences jointly cover with 95% probability.

failure_modes: Do not use realized completed exposure count as the planned-exposure channel weight when it can depend on current outcomes.
Do not select between the decision-only IUT and a simultaneous-bound procedure after seeing which one passes; the reporting/decision contract must be frozen before current evidence.
If either component e-process is not valid under the common joint filtration/stopping rule, the IUT argument does not repair it.

public_alignment.source: Berger-style intersection-union testing, summarized in Winkler et al. 2016 and current statistical references
public_alignment.relevance: An IUT rejects the union null only if every component null rejects at level alpha; no multiplicity correction is required for that conjunctive decision, though the test can be conservative.

scope_guards: This construction controls one conjunctive safe-decision error, not arbitrary post-hoc combinations of the two channels.
The derivation uses only stopped-time e-value validity and the union-null logic; no independence between the channels is assumed.
The component statistical contracts remain unchanged.
